55-ritu-brag.text: Fifty off twenty-eight balls, bhai! My boy is absolutely playing on another planet today.

64-ritu-lament.text: Oh no, he was looking so dangerous. Can someone please tell the others to carry on?

64-sunny-tease.text: Ritu, don't worry, even your pocket-rocket has to head back eventually. Time for a breather?

72-sunny-gloat.text: Finally, the middle order collapses. It was only a matter of time before they crumbled.

123-dev-lament.text: Bhai, this pitch is a disaster, why does Bhuvi even have to try hitting those?

123-sunny-tease.text: Dev, maybe Bhuvi should stick to the new ball and stop trying to be a batter.

159-ritu-tease.text: Dev bhai, seems your Bhuvi is just serving up freebies on a platter today, absolutely tragic.

162-sunny-tease.text: Dev, stop crying, twenty runs is just a generous gift to help the game stay interesting.

168-dev-tease.text: Look at that, you really thought your mystery architect could handle Mitchell? Absolute carnage, bro.

182-sunny-brag.text: Seifert is just playing a different game, fifty off thirty-four balls, try to keep up guys.

205-dev-tease.text: Eighteen in one over, your mystery spinner is looking more like a local club bowler, you.

211-sunny-nudge_away.text: You look stressed, go grab a chai, we will call you back when it gets exciting.

212-ritu-tease.text: Varun is getting taken apart, bro, your mystery spinner is looking very ordinary today.

219-sunny-callback.text: Hey you, come back to the screen right now, they only need twenty four off twenty eight balls.

220-sunny-lament.text: Seifert misses out on his century by seven runs, what a heartbreaking end to such an innings.

220-dev-tease.text: There goes your hero Sunny, missing the hundred and walking back after a brilliant knock.

235-sunny-final.text: What a stunning chase, Phillips finishes it in style and we take the game easily.

235-dev-final.text: Not Bhuvi again, why does this always happen to us in the final moments yaar.

R1-64-ritu|tease: Ritu, your pocket-rocket left-hander really stopped the bowlers from enjoying themselves for a while there.
Tough luck Ritu, even the most explosive players have to walk back sometime, right?
That was quite the show, but I guess it had to end eventually.
R1-123-dev|tease: Dev, seems like your swing king forgot he was holding a bat there.
That was a quick cameo, but not exactly what we needed at this stage.
R4-159-dev|tease: Dev, tell your swing king that the ball isn't supposed to fly into the stands.
Looks like Seifert is having fun with your favorite bowler today, Dev.
That shot was a bit too easy for Seifert, don't you think?
R3-205-me|comeback: Dev, keep laughing while your Bhuvi is basically a bowling machine for the opposition today.
Even an architect has to rebuild sometimes after a rough over like that, bro.
R4-212-me|comeback: Ritu, better Varun getting hit than watching Ishan throw his wicket away in every match.
Varun is just setting a trap, not that you would understand the mystery behind it.
R1-220-sunny|tease: Sunny, your fearless keeper finally fell just short after swinging at everything in sight.
At least your boy got ninety three before getting cleaned up Sunny, quite a knock.
R4-168-me|comeback: Dev bhai, tell your hero Bhuvi to teach Varun how to actually spin it, seriously.
Looks like your mystery spinner just turned into a practice bowler for Mitchell, didn't he?
